data.name: Fariyad
data.gender_notes: Fariyad is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who protects and serves Lord Vishnu. The name Fariyad is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Fara’ (protector) and ‘Yad’ (Yadavas, the descendants of Lord Krishna). The name Fariyad carries the meaning “Lord Vishnu's protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Fariyad usually hope their child will grow to embody lord vishnu's protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies protection, strength, and devotion to Lord Vishnu.
data.etymology: Fariyad belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Vishnu's protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fariyad total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
